reviews.text: Dr Zakine is a rare treasure. He warmly welcomes you into the consultation, takes time to ask about your pet, works quickly without making you feel rushed, and reassures you every step of the way. And on top of that, his expertise comes at a bargain price for Paris. You feel your pets are in good hands here.
I had to let my cat go 🐱 She received excellent care and a lot of empathy from all staff, thank you. This happened in August 2026. …

I highly recommend them. They are very accommodating when making appointments, their prices are very affordable for central Paris, and to top it all off, they are very patient during consultations, provide clear explanations, and do not push for medication or sterilization.
Very welcoming, punctual, takes excellent care of Tangho
This veterinary clinic is wonderful, the assistants are very professional and the vet is super nice; he treated my two cats with great patience and professionalism.

Appointments were consistently late, the organization was disappointing, and the service was unsatisfactory. I felt more like I was dealing with a purely commercial approach than a genuine focus on animal care and well-being. Overall, a disappointing experience.

I consulted this clinic in an emergency for my puppy and I am truly grateful. The vet and his assistant were very professional, compassionate, and attentive.

They took the time to treat my dog ​​thoroughly, clearly explained the treatment, and offered to provide follow-up photos.
The price was very reasonable considering the quality of care provided.
Even though it's about an hour's drive from my home, I will continue to have my dog ​​treated here without hesitation.
I felt reassured and well supported during a stressful time. Thank you again for your kindness and responsiveness. 🥹❤️
I am delighted

Excellent service for spaying my cat, with fair prices as listed on your website, thank you!
A no-nonsense, slightly old-fashioned clinic without too much self-righteous talk about animals – it's refreshing. I will definitely be back! 👌 …
Excellent practice. Very friendly receptionist. Competent and attentive doctor. And the fees are much more reasonable than elsewhere.
I've always taken my cat to Dr. Zakine, in whom I have 100% confidence. He's extremely competent and a great listener. I highly recommend him!
Great vet & very helpful to those who have just moved to France! He also speaks some English, so that is helpful with some very terms.
Excellent care for our beloved pet.

Dr. Zakine is extraordinary, incredibly kind and attentive; the animals feel reassured. Years of experience and professionalism, his fees are clearly displayed, his secretaries are friendly and responsive, and if you ask him to call you back, he does so immediately, answering all your questions clearly and kindly.

Thank you so much, Doctor.

I highly recommend him with complete confidence.
Mrs. Maksic

After five years with Dr. Zakine as my veterinarian, I highly recommend him.

They are very attentive, available, and friendly.

Having known the grandfather, father, and son Zakine, I thank you immensely for the warm welcome, your availability, and the quality of your work with our Kyle.
Thank you also to the rest of the team who have always been able to respond to our requests.
We will never forget what you have done for Kyle.

The clinic has a lovely reception area. The vet is reassuring and professional. No complaints whatsoever.
My cat developed an eye ulcer very quickly, and the clinic was responsive, providing a fast and effective diagnosis and timely surgery at a reasonable price. A huge thank you!

Thank you so much for your advice regarding my two-week-old kitten, Drancy, and we're going back to see the vet on September 28th. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic; the staff are very attentive.

The veterinarian is very attentive to owners' questions about their pets. Very gentle and extremely competent. I highly recommend them. Vaccination prices are reasonable. The reception is very pleasant.
My vet for the past 4 years, I highly recommend him!

Excellent veterinarian, attentive and responsive.

Plus, very competitive rates for the area.

Highly recommended.
A very good clinic; the whole team is very professional and responsible. Highly recommended!

I had my cat spayed there, and there were no issues with the operation itself; the follow-up care was good, even for removing the stitches.

The receptionist was very kind and smiling; not a bad team, just a bad experience...

On the other hand, I was very disappointed with the treatment of my other cat. My brother had brought her in because she had a worrying lump near her anus. They simply expressed her glands, put a cone on her, and that was it—apparently nothing alarming. This was about a year ago.

I called the clinic again recently because he used to bring her there regularly. This time, she was bleeding, and it kept coming back. The clinic was closed at 1 p.m. on a Saturday, and they asked me on the phone if it was an emergency. But what do I know? I'm not a professional; you tell me? All of this was said in a very nonchalant tone. So, I switched clinics because I had no choice, going back to the one where I'd taken my little cat in an emergency one Sunday. The vet there gave me more explanations, not just a couple of sentences, offered advice, and really checked my cat's overall condition more thoroughly, not just express her glands and say goodbye. I went back to the same clinic today because the problem persisted (a month later). I learned that it wasn't related to her anal glands at all, and that there were nodular growths in my cat's rectum, which eventually required surgery at 14 years old. Going from "nothing serious, she just needed her glands expressed/it's just an irritation" and a cone to prevent her from licking herself too much to this, I can't believe it. I'm definitely changing clinics; the other one has no time constraints, is open every day, including Sundays, and all day long, with better follow-up and advice. While it's fine for a simple sterilization, anything else is too much hassle and a bad experience. Out of respect, I won't mention the clinic's name, but it's located opposite the Filles du Calvaire metro station for those interested who need to travel if there are no available appointments here.

I'm not necessarily advising against this clinic, though; it all depends on what you want done there, I think.

After calling the clinic on Cours de Vincennes this morning, where our Lewis is usually seen, there were no appointments available, but we were able to get one for today at the clinic on Boulevard Richard Lenoir. We received a very warm welcome, were very attentive to our cat's concerns, and received a very thorough examination and assessment. A treatment plan was established, along with helpful advice. I am truly grateful and delighted to have my cat treated by Zakine & Co. He is not the first cat we have seen, and in addition to the excellent care, the warm welcome and compassionate approach are truly remarkable. They reassure us and support us even during the most difficult times. I cannot thank them enough.

Dr. Zakine is a serious and compassionate professional.
He took care of my cat and my beloved Labrador, who passed away a week ago.
He cared for her with great dedication and empathy. I am very grateful to him.
The best for my Niki (a pug). Dr. Zakine has shown wisdom and kindness every time for the past ten years… and his staff are always kind and professional. Thank you.

Listening, compassion, and professionalism are the core values ​​our animals will find at the clinic.

Thank you to Dr. Zakine and his team 🙂🙏
Finally, a vet who doesn't try to rip us off! Genuine advice, reasonable prices—we now know where to go for our two pets.

It's hard to find a good vet in Paris-- especially one with reasonable prices. He is both. Genuinely cares about his animal patients and their humans. Very responsive and goes above and beyond to make sure all is well. Thank you!!

I'm absolutely satisfied with this vet, 10/10! My dog ​​had a stomach bug, and he went straight to the source of the problem. He prescribed the right treatment, and by the day of her appointment, she was fine! 👍 Four months ago, I also had her spayed, and frankly, everything went wonderfully, from her recovery to the stitch removal; her scar is practically nonexistent.

I highly recommend him. The quality is excellent, and the prices are truly reasonable for someone who knows his job and charges a fair price. 😊😊😊
